before: In an ordered room, the suggestions-only policy accepted a party's own comment that named a discussion they opened as a marker change in a batch, written under the party's name. A host had to map the editor's selection to node ids itself to send a marker request.
after: The suggestions-only policy refuses a party's marker in a batch of changes by name (policy-marker, reason marker); a party marks a discussion through the marker request, which keeps its checks. OrderedRoom.submit tells the policy how a change came (source), OrderedLocalRoom checks a marker message as a request, and the session's requestSelectionMarker marks the editor's held selection.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the protocol frames and the Yjs document format do not change. A logged marker replays as before, because replay runs no policy; only a new party marker in a batch is refused, as the host writes a party's marker after its request.
